'''Odionate gunships''' were medium-sized starships used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s independent princedom the [[Odionate]] during the [[Second Charge Matrica]]. These gunships saw action during the [[Raid on The Spike|defense]] of the mobile space station [[The Spike (space station)|''The Spike'']], destroying many [[Daimanate starfighter]]s.
